test_policy.notes: SAT and ACT scores are not required for general admission; submitted official scores may be used for orientation placement or to fulfil Core Competency Requirements.

requirements.supplemental_essays: 500-word application essay strongly encouraged (optional); Honors College applicants add supplemental materials.
requirements.notes: Fee is $50 for Arizona residents and $80 for non-Arizona residents or residents of other U.S. states (the page does not name an international rate). Recommendations are not listed among review materials; optional materials are SAT/ACT, resume and personal statement. Some students are admitted to The A Center (undeclared support program).

deadlines.label: Early Action (priority for admission, merit aid and Honors College), fall 2027
deadlines.notes: Decision release begins January 15, 2027. Applications after Nov 1 move to Regular Decision, reviewed on a space-available basis with decisions released in batches in the spring; no fixed Regular Decision deadline is published for first-year main campus.

deadlines.label: National College Decision Day (enrollment fee)
deadlines.notes: Page 'highly encourages' claiming a spot by May 1; not stated as a hard deadline.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Required for applicants whose primary language is not English or who attended school in a non-English-speaking country, regardless of citizenship. Waived with 3 years of regular English classes at a C or better at an accredited American high school (domestic or abroad), 3 years at an English-medium high school with C, IB English A HL 5, IGCSE/O-Level English C, or a US college composition course with C. Scores must be dated within 2 years.

english.notes: Listed as '4' for tests after January 2026. TOEFL Essentials 8.5 also accepted.
Cambridge English Qualification / CEFR 180 or C1.

aid.notes: International students do not qualify for federal Title IV aid. Everyone is considered for merit tuition scholarships when they apply; apply by the Nov 1 Early Action deadline for priority.

tier_notes.math_physics: Astronomy and optical sciences are among the best in the US.
